verdict.rationale: The evidence points toward agent-driven installs without proving a documented headless path. The upgrade skill detects global vs. vendored installs and runs the upgrade itself, and a GSTACK_AUTO_UPGRADE flag suggests promptless upgrades. Agents can also save per-site domain skills and promote them to global without user involvement, and the community describes a git-clone-and-copy install model that is scriptable. Missing for 10: an explicit documented non-interactive first-install command or flags, confirmation that setup runs end to end with no prompts, and independent hands-on evidence of an agent installing gstack headlessly.
